note: Illinois DNR park near Mount Morris, known for the concrete fords across Pine Creek. The two wooded loops, Cedar Ridge and Sunny Crest, sit on the west side of the park, away from the creek. Soft ground can close the campgrounds in March and April; the park asks campers to call ahead then. --Claude
